# --description--

一个协议可以建立在另一个协议之上。在冒号后写下一个协议的名称，会让新协议**继承**旧协议的每一项要求：
```swift
protocol Named {
    var name: String { get }
}

protocol Aged: Named {
    var age: Int { get }
}
```
遵循 `Aged` 的类型必须提供 `age` *和* `name`，并且它在任何地方都被视为 `Named` 类型。一个协议可以同时继承多个协议，用逗号分隔。

# --instructions--

声明一个继承自 `Named` 的协议 `Timed`，并添加一个可读的 `Int` 属性 `seconds`，然后让 `Track` 遵循 `Timed`

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --seed--

```swift
protocol Named {
    var name: String { get }
}

struct Track {
    var name: String
    var seconds: Int
}
```

# --before-asserts--

```swift
extension Timed {
    func label() -> String {
        return "\(name) \(seconds)"
    }
}

func _name(_ n: Named) -> String {
    return n.name
}
```

# --asserts--

名为 `Intro`、时长 `90` 秒的曲目必须标记为 `Intro 90`

```swift
tryCatch(Track(name: "Intro", seconds: 90).label() == "Intro 90")
```

名为 `Outro`、时长 `5` 秒的曲目必须标记为 `Outro 5`

```swift
tryCatch(Track(name: "Outro", seconds: 5).label() == "Outro 5")
```

名为 `Gap`、时长 `0` 秒的曲目必须标记为 `Gap 0`

```swift
tryCatch(Track(name: "Gap", seconds: 0).label() == "Gap 0")
```

`Timed` 值必须能作为 `Named` 值使用

```swift
tryCatch(_name(Track(name: "Intro", seconds: 90)) == "Intro")
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
protocol Named {
    var name: String { get }
}

protocol Timed: Named {
    var seconds: Int { get }
}

struct Track: Timed {
    var name: String
    var seconds: Int
}
```
